appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Prevalence of Species Z in US States'
Legend: Color scale from 'Low' (dark red) to 'High' (light yellow), with numerical markers at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100.
State of Pennsylvania (PA) is colored dark red, indicating the highest prevalence category on the scale.
State of New Jersey (NJ) is colored dark red, indicating the highest prevalence category on the scale.
State of Delaware (DE) is colored light yellow, indicating a low prevalence category on the scale.

public_definitions: Review the state prevalence dashboard, then open the state prevalence record that should be routed into the highest-prevalence priority follow-up workflow.
Use the state prevalence dashboard as the evidence source for selecting the highest-prevalence state record.
Highest-prevalence state route: The state with the highest prevalence value on the dashboard.
